role: exploratory mechanism diagnosis on previously collected training-scene traces; not an independent confirmatory test
source_fact: DUET vilmodel.py sums logits of local visited neighbors into bw_logits, then adds that same value to every remote unvisited candidate.
hypothesis: Using the executed first-hop local evidence for each remote target may expose decision information lost by shared backward fusion. Common-logit-shift sensitivity is a mathematical symptom only, not proof of natural errors.
sampling: Every saved state; descriptive coverage includes forced endings, regret interventions use exactly eligible states; no score/label-dependent subset selection.
data: Saved weighted global/local logits, current discovered graph and exposed local neighbors only. Ground-truth costs isolated for diagnostics. Reconstruct graph using only revealed endpoints from connectivity positions; no unseen edges.
parity_gate: Reconstruct upstream chronological FloydGraph paths, node/visited order and all-pairs distances; reproduce saved original fused logits and executed next paths. Refuse interpretation on disagreement.
shift_scope: Uniform shifts applied to every valid weighted local logit, preserving its local softmax. Original remote logits should respond K*c and STOP/local c. Route/mean/logsumexp controls should be shift invariant in ideal arithmetic; numeric tie effects must be reported separately. HSPR-style remote=2g should have zero response to local common shift, while STOP/local respond c; it is not an invariant control.
counterfactual_scope: Single saved-state score changes, not complete navigation SR/SPL.
promotion: Do not train a paper method merely because a fixed score improves one offline count. Require meaningful natural coverage, useful held-out decision evidence beyond mean/logsumexp simple corrections, prior-art distinction and registered complete-navigation controls.
prior_art_status: HSPR directly identifies the DUET shared backward-sum issue. Discovering that issue is not novel. Actual first-hop use is under targeted review.

prior_art.control_scope: Use the corresponding remote=2*saved weighted global score rule on frozen DUET only; this does not reproduce HSPR model/training/proximity.
prior_art.source_anchor: residual fusion; fused_logits[i, j] += global_logits[i, j]

implementation_repair.cause: MatterSim parses JSON pose as float, stores glm::vec3, and promotes those rounded coordinates to Python floats. Direct use of JSON double coordinates differed from actual collected observations.
implementation_repair.coordinate_semantics: JSON pose coordinate -> IEEE float32 -> Python float, then original DUET double differences/NumPy sqrt.
implementation_repair.gates: No graph-distance or fused-logit tolerance changed; exact FP32 equality remains required.
